lines.zh: 我拿鼻子拱开落叶找根茎
lines.en: I root through fallen leaves with my snout.

lines.zh: 林子里这条路我熟得很
lines.en: I know this forest path very well.

lines.zh: 四只蹄子踩过枯枝，咔咔响
lines.en: My four hooves crackle over the dry twigs.

lines.zh: 前面那片草根归我了
lines.en: Those grass roots ahead belong to me.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但一路都在吃
lines.en: I walk slowly, but I eat the whole way.

lines.zh: 背上的鬃毛被灌木挂住了
lines.en: The brush snagged the bristles on my back.

lines.zh: 群体在前面，我殿后
lines.en: The herd is ahead, and I hold the rear.

lines.zh: 泥坑就在前面，我要去滚一圈
lines.en: The mud wallow is close and I want a roll.

lines.zh: 这片稀树草原晒得背发烫
lines.en: This savanna sun makes my back burn.

lines.zh: 獠牙蹭到树干，得磨一磨
lines.en: My tusks scraped a trunk, so they need a rub.

lines.zh: 我绕开那块尖石头，蹄子娇气
lines.en: I go around that sharp stone, my hooves are delicate.

lines.zh: 走两步拱一下，这就是我的路
lines.en: Two steps, one root; that is how I travel.

lines.zh: 我站在树荫里，耳朵扇风
lines.en: I stand in the shade and fan my ears.

lines.zh: 今天不追谁，也没谁来追我
lines.en: Nobody chases me today, and I chase nobody.

lines.zh: 胃里那点草根还在反刍
lines.en: Those grass roots are still turning in my stomach.

lines.zh: 有只鸟落在我背上，随它去
lines.en: A bird landed on my back, so let it stay.

lines.zh: 我这獠牙，长得还算齐
lines.en: My tusks have grown in fairly even.

lines.zh: 地上这块泥，凉得正合适
lines.en: This patch of mud is exactly the right coolness.

lines.zh: 远处有狼嚎，我听着就行
lines.en: Wolves are howling far off, and I just listen.

lines.zh: 有人想给我装鞍，那不可能
lines.en: Someone wants to saddle me, and that is impossible.

lines.zh: 我打个响鼻，林子都听见了
lines.en: I snort once and the whole forest hears it.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，该换个阴凉处
lines.en: The sun shifted, so I should find new shade.

lines.zh: 我这条命值十四点，够结实的
lines.en: I have fourteen points of health, plenty sturdy.

lines.zh: 猪是猪，我是我，别混了
lines.en: A pig is a pig, and I am something else.

lines.zh: 树皮蹭痒最舒服了
lines.en: Rubbing my itch on tree bark is the best.

lines.zh: 谁在远处喊，我不爱搭理
lines.en: Someone is calling from afar, and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 林子里有橡果落下来，砸在背上。
lines.en: An acorn drops in the woods and lands on my back.

lines.zh: 我拿獠牙蹭树干，蹭掉一层皮。
lines.en: I scrape my tusks on a trunk and peel a layer off.

lines.zh: 泥坑边上，我躺了整整一下午。
lines.en: By the mud wallow I lay the whole afternoon.

lines.zh: 谁要骑我，先问问这对牙。
lines.en: Anyone who wants to ride me can ask these tusks first.

lines.zh: 你身上有熟猪排的味道
lines.en: You smell of cooked pork chops.

lines.zh: 别把手伸过来，我獠牙不认人
lines.en: Keep your hand back, my tusks do not know you.

lines.zh: 你站那么直，是想显得高吗
lines.en: Standing so upright, are you trying to look tall?

lines.zh: 我在看你腰上有没有鞍
lines.en: I am checking your waist for a saddle.

lines.zh: 你这眼神，跟猎人一个样
lines.en: That look in your eye is a hunter's look.

lines.zh: 靠近点，我闻闻你袋子里装的
lines.en: Come closer, let me smell what is in your bag.

lines.zh: 我不怕人，但也不亲近人
lines.en: I do not fear people, and I do not befriend them.

lines.zh: 你靴子上沾了别处的泥
lines.en: There is mud from somewhere else on your boots.

lines.zh: 想骑我就算了，我背上不装东西
lines.en: Forget riding me; my back carries nothing.

lines.zh: 你手里那根胡萝卜，我勉强看看
lines.en: That carrot in your hand, I will barely consider it.

lines.zh: 我们隔着三步说话正好
lines.en: Three steps apart is just right for us to talk.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的功夫，我就能冲过去
lines.en: In the blink of your eye, I could charge.

lines.zh: 谁用剑背敲我，太没规矩
lines.en: Who struck me with the flat of a sword?

lines.zh: 这一下打得我耳朵嗡嗡响
lines.en: That blow left my ears ringing.

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛被血黏住了
lines.en: My bristles are matted with blood.

lines.zh: 疼归疼，我可不会跑
lines.en: It hurts, but I am not running.

lines.zh: 你敢再打，我就顶回去
lines.en: Hit me again and I will shove right back.

lines.zh: 皮糙肉厚，也架不住你这么砍
lines.en: Thick hide cannot take endless cuts like that.

lines.zh: 我退到你打不着的地方
lines.en: I am backing out of your reach.

lines.zh: 这一道口子在肩上，很深
lines.en: This gash on my shoulder is deep.

lines.zh: 打我可以，别碰我的崽
lines.en: You may hit me, but never my young.

lines.zh: 我哼一声，是因为真的疼
lines.en: I grunt because it genuinely hurts.

lines.zh: 是块根茎，先给我闻闻
lines.en: A root vegetable, let me smell it first.

lines.zh: 这果子掉地上，就是我的了
lines.en: This fruit fell on the ground, so it is mine.

lines.zh: 我拱土一整天，就为这一口
lines.en: I root all day just for one bite like this.

lines.zh: 别举太高，我脖子抬不起来
lines.en: Do not hold it too high, my neck does not lift well.

lines.zh: 这味道像雨后的林地
lines.en: This smells like woodland after rain.

lines.zh: 我不挑，烂一点的也吃
lines.en: I am not fussy, even slightly rotten will do.

lines.zh: 你把食物放下，我自己来拿
lines.en: Put the food down and I will take it myself.

lines.zh: 嚼起来要脆，软的没意思
lines.en: It must crunch; soft food is no fun.

lines.zh: 为这口吃的，我肯走近两步
lines.en: For this bite I will come two steps closer.

lines.zh: 又是南瓜，我吃得有点腻了
lines.en: Pumpkin again; I am getting a little tired of it.

lines.zh: 你撞我，我肩膀可不软
lines.en: You bumped me, and my shoulder is not soft.

lines.zh: 我这体重，撞一下够你退半步
lines.en: At my weight, one bump sets you back half a step.

lines.zh: 让开点，我要去那片泥坑
lines.en: Move aside, I am heading to that wallow.

lines.zh: 蹄子碾过你的靴尖，让开些
lines.en: My hooves just grazed your boot tip, move aside.

lines.zh: 别从后面推我，我会回头
lines.en: Do not push me from behind, or I will turn around.

lines.zh: 我这獠牙贴着你的腿过去了
lines.en: My tusk passed right beside your leg.

lines.zh: 挤在一起，谁也走不动
lines.en: Crowded like this, neither of us can move.

lines.zh: 你退后，我脾气不太好
lines.en: Back off a bit, my temper is uneven.

lines.zh: 撞完这一下，我还是走我的路
lines.en: After that bump I go back to my own path.

lines.zh: 獠牙是摆设，别当真
lines.en: The tusks are for show, do not take them seriously.

lines.zh: 那头母猪在橡树下等我
lines.en: That sow is waiting under the oak.

lines.zh: 我竖起鬃毛，让她看见我
lines.en: I raise my bristles so she can see me.

lines.zh: 我们俩拱同一片土，很配
lines.en: We root the same patch of soil, a good match.

lines.zh: 她嫌我獠牙长，我倒觉得威风
lines.en: She thinks my tusks are long; I think they are noble.

lines.zh: 以后这窝小猪由我守着
lines.en: From now on I will guard this litter.

lines.zh: 别站太近，她护崽很凶
lines.en: Do not stand close, she guards the young fiercely.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，蹄声很整齐
lines.en: Walking side by side, our hooves fall in rhythm.

lines.zh: 泥坑得分她一半，这是规矩
lines.en: She gets half the wallow; that is the rule.

lines.zh: 我蹭蹭她的脖子，算是问好
lines.en: I nuzzle her neck as a way of greeting.

lines.zh: 橡树下那头母猪，跟我挺对脾气
lines.en: That sow under the oak matches my temper well.

lines.zh: 地上有颗果子，我一嘴叼起
lines.en: A fruit on the ground, and I snatch it up.

lines.zh: 我用鼻子把土块翻开
lines.en: I flip the clod over with my snout.

lines.zh: 这块根茎卡在石缝里
lines.en: This root is stuck in a crack between stones.

lines.zh: 捡起来的东西，我先闻再吃
lines.en: Whatever I pick up, I sniff before eating.

lines.zh: 有东西掉进草里，我拱出来了
lines.en: Something fell in the grass, and I rooted it out.

lines.zh: 我嘴里塞满了，说不出话
lines.en: My mouth is full, so I cannot speak.

lines.zh: 这蘑菇颜色怪，我绕开它
lines.en: That mushroom looks odd, so I leave it alone.

lines.zh: 铁片硌牙，我吐出来了
lines.en: The iron bit hurt my teeth, so I spat it out.

lines.zh: 别的猪在抢，我得快点
lines.en: The other pigs are grabbing, so I must hurry.

lines.zh: 叼着走远点，慢慢吃
lines.en: I will carry it off and eat it slowly.

lines.zh: 谁在草丛里盯着我的崽
lines.en: Someone is watching my young from the grass.

lines.zh: 那股味道不是食草动物的
lines.en: That scent does not belong to a plant eater.

lines.zh: 你踩断了树枝，我听见了
lines.en: You snapped a branch, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 我低下头，是在给你机会走
lines.en: I lower my head to give you a chance to leave.

lines.zh: 这片地是我的，树也是
lines.en: This ground is mine, and so are the trees.

lines.zh: 有只狼绕过来了，我盯住它
lines.en: A wolf circled in, and I keep my eyes on it.

lines.zh: 谁动我的食槽，我就顶谁
lines.en: Whoever touches my trough gets the tusks.

lines.zh: 我前蹄刨土，这是警告
lines.en: My front hoof scrapes the dirt as a warning.

lines.zh: 那家伙背对着我，机会来了
lines.en: That one has its back to me, a fine chance.

lines.zh: 我不主动惹事，但不怕事
lines.en: I do not start trouble, and I do not fear it.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，一步步逼近
lines.en: I lower my body and close in step by step.

lines.zh: 它退一步，我就进两步
lines.en: It retreats one step, and I take two.

lines.zh: 鼻子里喷着气，我跑起来了
lines.en: Snorting hard, I break into a run.

lines.zh: 别绕树，我比你想的快
lines.en: Do not circle the tree, I am faster than you think.

lines.zh: 三米之内，獠牙就到了
lines.en: Within three meters, the tusks arrive.

lines.zh: 我盯的是腿，不是脸
lines.en: I aim for the legs, not the face.

lines.zh: 它想爬上石头，那正好
lines.en: It wants to climb the rock, which suits me.

lines.zh: 追得急了，我连路都不看
lines.en: Chasing hard, I do not even watch the path.

lines.zh: 它开始喘了，我还稳着呢
lines.en: It is panting now, and I am still steady.

lines.zh: 这一冲，我攒了半天的劲
lines.en: This charge has half a day of strength behind it.

lines.zh: 獠牙从下往上一挑
lines.en: A tusk swings up from below.

lines.zh: 这一顶，它整个人都歪了
lines.en: One shove and it is knocked crooked.

lines.zh: 我只用了两点的力气
lines.en: I put only two points of force into that.

lines.zh: 撞在肋骨上，声音闷闷的
lines.en: It landed on the ribs with a dull sound.

lines.zh: 它挡了一下，我獠牙发麻
lines.en: It blocked, and my tusks went numb.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把它掀翻在地
lines.en: I twist my head and tip it to the ground.

lines.zh: 打完我就退，不追远
lines.en: Once it is done I back off and do not chase far.

lines.zh: 蹄子也踩，不只是獠牙
lines.en: My hooves strike too, not only the tusks.

lines.zh: 它往后退，我顶得更狠
lines.en: It steps back, and I push harder.

lines.zh: 这一架打完，我鬃毛都乱了
lines.en: After this scrap my bristles are all messed up.

lines.zh: 我生在稀树草原的干草里
lines.en: I was born in the dry grass of the savanna.

lines.zh: 第一口吃的是带泥的草根
lines.en: My first bite was a muddy grass root.

lines.zh: 母兽拱开落叶，让我跟上
lines.en: My mother rooted the leaves aside for me to follow.

lines.zh: 那时獠牙还没长出来
lines.en: Back then my tusks had not come in yet.

lines.zh: 我跟着一群猪在林中走
lines.en: I walked the woods with a whole herd of pigs.

lines.zh: 这块林地的味道我记住了
lines.en: I have memorized the smell of this woodland.

lines.zh: 睁开眼，太阳正好在头顶
lines.en: I opened my eyes with the sun straight overhead.

lines.zh: 我第一次打响鼻，把鸟吓飞了
lines.en: My first snort scattered a flock of birds.

lines.zh: 树根旁那个浅坑是我睡的地方
lines.en: That shallow hollow by the roots is where I slept.

lines.zh: 出生那天，泥土是湿的
lines.en: The day I was born, the soil was wet.

lines.zh: 现在我得自己找食了
lines.en: Now I have to find my own food.

lines.zh: 蹄子站稳，先学怎么拱土
lines.en: Hooves steady, first I learn to root.

lines.zh: 毛烧焦的味道，难闻死了
lines.en: The smell of burnt bristles is disgusting.

lines.zh: 从坡上滚下来，獠牙磕断了
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and chipped a tusk.

lines.zh: 泥坑太深，我呛了一口
lines.en: The wallow was too deep and I swallowed mud.

lines.zh: 一声炸响，我被掀进树丛
lines.en: A blast threw me into the bushes.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎在背上，还晃着
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my back, still wobbling.

lines.zh: 那道光让我四蹄发软
lines.en: That light made all four of my legs weak.

lines.zh: 拱了半天土，什么也没找到
lines.en: I rooted half the day and found nothing.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边的树上，耳朵聋了
lines.en: Lightning hit the tree beside me and deafened me.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我一直在往下掉
lines.en: The ground vanished and I keep falling.
